Nina (Product): quick sync 0min0 1) define MVP for routing that balances isolation vs cost
Jae (Eng): three small pillars: policy-as-config, edge cache for fast eval, and fallback chain (model -> region -> pool)
Ravi (Arch): tradeoffs: dedicated pools = simple SLA but low utilisation; shared+fallback = better economics but needs clear observable behavior
Marta (Sales): customers want predictable uplifts. need a simple SKU table (Bronze/Silver/Gold) and a migration ETA for upgrades
Jae (Eng): MVP acceptance (proposed): policy proto + versioning, edge cache with TTL, fallback semantics documented, canary mirror for 5 pilot tenants
Ravi (Arch): addops: per-tenant telemetry, deterministic eviction policy, and a global circuit-breaker to avoid cascade failures
Nina (Product): timeline ask: can we do a 2w spike then a private beta at wk8 and GA ~wk14? sales needs beta slots earlier if possible
Marta (Sales): I'll collect pilot customers and draft the one-pager. prefer phrasing "graceful fallback" not "eviction" in customer docs
ops-bot: canary deploy scheduled to staging: routing-spike v0.1 0min tests passing
Jae (Eng): owning spike. will post perf numbers and a tiny policy example in 48h
Ravi (Arch): dependency list added to design doc: model registry, tenant metadata, rollout automation
Nina (Product): actions: Jae/Ravi spike (2w), Marta sales matrix, ops set canary. reconvene next Tue 11am. end-of-thread recap: ship shared-first with a clear paid path to dedicated lanes.
